item.tib: yang zab gu ru'i thugs sgrub las dbang chog ye shes rang gsal
item.coloph: zhes o rgyan thugs kyi sras mchog 'gro ba'i mgon po gar dbang rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis/ gnas mchog seng ge g.yu rdzong nas rin po che'i shog ser mkha' 'gro'i brda ris shin tu gsol ba btab pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi zab gter rnams spyan drangs shing / phyis shing mo bya yi lor bkra shis mthong smin gling du mkha' 'gro'i brda ris gsal ba las zhal bshus te dag par phab nas/ yig ge rig byed po ris bral rgyal bstan 'dzin pa g.yung drung 'gyur med pas bgyis shing*/ ris bral srid pa'i 'gro khams snying po'i byang chub pad+ma drwa ba brgyan pa'i zhing khams su dbugs 'byin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
